messages:
Alex: heads-up — redispatching prefetch credits is showing up as big 'savings' for some routes but we're seeing a measurable tail-latency bump on the origin route. can we surface that in the econ panel?
Maria: ugh yeah i've seen a couple of tenants hit this. metrics show 95p latency up 30–50ms when credits move off-hotpath.
Devon: is this the same as the prefetched-kv->on-demand handoff? curious if it's a routing policy bug or just expected tradeoff.
Alex: it's the redispatch we do when capacity changes. credits are applied to whatever route served the prefetch originally, but when we reassign the request to a different host the credit attribution moves and the origin shows higher latency.
Jordan: suggestion: show a 'credit displacement' line in the cost breakdown that links to a latency delta ribbon. small UX affordance: an inline badge that says "credits moved -> latency risk".
Sam: can we compute a per-route delta in the pipeline? something like: 
```
per_route_delta = post_redispatch.latency_p95 - pre_redispatch.latency_p95
credit_moved = pre_redispatch.prefetch_credit - post_redispatch.prefetch_credit
```
If credit_moved > 0 && per_route_delta > threshold then flag.
Maria: that formula looks fine. main perf concern: we need to avoid noisy alerts for micro deltas. maybe exponential smoothing + sample by tenant.
Devon: from infra side we can add a telemetry tag `redispatch_reason` to the trace so the console can filter. would require a light schema bump in trace metadata but low cost.
OpsBot: deploy: econ-panel/credit-dispatch-propagation @ canary -> 3/5 hosts (succeeds) :white_check_mark:
Alex: nice. next question — how should rollouts surface this? i.e., when we enable redispatch autopilot, show a toggle + preview that simulates credits moving and projected latency delta.
Jordan: preview should be deterministic: simulate using sampled traces from the last 24h and show a PDF of expected p95 shift. slider for sample rate.
Sam: UI nit: don't bury the simulation behind Settings. Put a small 'what-if' button next to the route cost card.
Maria: operational ask: add a per-tenant opt-out flag; some enterprise customers will want strict sticky-routing and nullify redispatch at cost of not leveraging prefetch savings.
Devon: technially easy: honor tenant routing_policy.sticky_prefetch = true before dispatch. will add API gate.
Alex: API shape proposal (very small):
```
PATCH /v1/routes/{route_id}
{ "routing_policy": { "redispatch_mode": "auto|sticky|manual" } }
```
Sam: perfect. can we also add an annotation in the billing preview that explains 'savings shown assume redispatch_mode=auto' ? legal will like the clarity.
Maria: agree. ok i'll mock a panel: cost + credit displacement ribbon + latency preview + tenant opt-out. will post screenshots in #design when ready.
Alex: thanks — i'll follow up with a short eval harness to quantify p95 impact for the canary.
Jordan: +1, and let's gate the UI behind feature-flag `econ_redispatch_preview` so we can iterate.
Alex: sounds good. tagging @Devon for telemetry PR and @Maria for UX.
Devon: on it — opening PR for trace tag + small API change. ETA EOD.
Maria: thanks all :)
